evidenceScope.revisionMeaning: input_revision is packet lineage, not a claim that all inspected bytes are committed at that SHA. Sources are the live working-tree files, including concurrent lead work; whole-file hashes identify the inspected snapshots.
evidenceScope.freshness: Revalidate these digests before implementation. Any root integration changing a referenced file invalidates that file's line anchors and requires reinspection; never relabel stale evidence as the new revision.
evidenceScope.inputManifest: Both specified manifest SHA-256 values matched shasum output during inspection.
evidenceScope.tools: codegraph reported no project index; fallback was scoped read/grep/glob. One scoped find failed with judge provider 402, so it supplied no absence evidence; literal symbol search and direct reads supplied the navigation evidence instead.
evidenceScope.coverageLimit: No broad foundation/caller survey. Shared transport/attachment/projection owner paths remain an explicit integration prerequisite, not invented patch locations. Preflight artifact validation is separate from feature verification.

nextExecutableAction: Lead first records wave0 committed revision and accepts current RS-ADM-01/RS-MCP-01 receipts plus published WP foundation/provider interfaces. Revalidate report source digests and re-read changed seams; settle canonical file subtype/version refs, store/migrations/gateway ownership and concrete transport/projection patch anchors. Then implement the normative version-contracts/file-versions.sql/authorized-preview vertical slice against accepted foundations: upload -> quarantine -> authorized preview/download with denied actor and reload/hash verification, before layering sharing/revoke/anchors/contextual UI and all remaining gates. This worker has no source-integration authority.
risks: Missing normative service/domain directories may tempt a second SIG-only store or fake backend; the spec explicitly requires common persistence/Revision2 authority and real adapters.
Current file:/Page identity, generic revisionId and source-authorized text descriptors are not immutable FileVersion ACL semantics. Settling subtype/alias mapping is a hidden foundation gate.

Path-based PDF title/copy/reveal and local readFile APIs must not receive cloud refs or raw object paths. PDF annotation rendering is enabled; active/external content isolation requires observed adversarial proof.

A presigned object URL that remains usable after revoke can defeat current-policy read denial before TTL. The real delivery adapter must define/check policyEpoch and expiry rather than promise cache purge alone solves access revocation.
Version-scoped audience grants must not implicitly include future versions; stale audience previews require revision conflict, not silent broadening.
OCR/search/agent/memory/notification retraction is part of the feature, not a UI-only extension; denied title/count/body and cross-workspace dedup existence leakage require negative tests.
Sensitive draft preservation must coexist with revoked grants: no global/private indefinite retention, replay or offline mutation without current policy.
Existing Page sharing and execution grants must remain separate and regression-tested; introducing public resource permissions through Page publish is forbidden.
Concurrent root wave0 edits can invalidate hashes between inspection and verifier; retain failure evidence and re-read changed files before refreshing references.
Feature completion requires Linux, pinned macOS and real-provider lanes, independent review and exact-commit artifacts; successful preflight JSON validation is not feature proof.
